replay.detail: No projection replay or launch replay is introduced.

schema.detail: No additional database or runtime-record layout change.

rules.detail: No replicated claim or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: Start receipts carry writer-set operation_status verified only after exact operation/incarnation verification, and producer-closed only after positive exact producer closure. Ordinary failure cannot forge a closure label or success. Request/result runtime kind, ID, operation, original desired token and evidence are bound in the completion transaction; conflicting inputs are refused. Native retirement uses the separately classified retired status. Existing fields and claim kinds are used; UUID shape alone is never proof, and capability advertisement remains unchanged.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond the normal deployment restart already classified for the start-operation upgrade.

manual.detail: Consumers must verify exact operation/request/runtime/incarnation bindings along with the writer proof status. This integration obligation introduces no new operator command.

recovery.detail: The separately classified database and runtime-state restoration procedure applies; this change adds no separate migration.
